question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring config, fold this requirement into the broader origin-delivery policy, or keep WebChat delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature intentionally sends Control UI output to an external conversation selected from stored route state, so code inspection cannot decide the product and privacy boundary.

options.title: Define Under Origin-Delivery Policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship Narrow Default-Off Mirror Flag
options.body: Add the requested session config only after maintainers accept a separate WebChat mirroring policy and require live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery Only
options.body: Decline automatic mirroring and rely on explicit delivery, docking, or future UI affordances for cross-channel sends.

recommendation.title: Define Under Origin-Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and has recent current-line provenance on the WebChat routing guard being reviewed.
